slides.texte_overlay:
Skills that will make you
unforgettable
Learn to write a good message. A thoughtful birthday text, a proper thank you note. Words that took effort stay with people for years. Few men bother.
Get good at hosting. Simple food, good music, everyone introduced. People never forget the evenings where they felt welcome.
Learn to give a short toast. Thirty seconds, one memory, one wish. Being the man who can say a few warm words at the right moment is rare.
Become good at one thing people can ask you about. Wine, football history, plants, old cars. Your little expertise makes you memorable and easy to talk to.
Become someone who always knows a little more. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and people often remember the facts I share.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. People often remember the facts I share.

slides.texte_overlay: Learn to dance a little. Nothing fancy, just enough to join in at a wedding. The guy who isn't afraid of the dance floor is the one everyone remembers.
Practise remembering faces and stories. "You're the one who climbed Kilimanjaro!" Recognising people makes them feel important and seen.
